content.text:
Campaign ran Jan 16–27, 2027 (Dublin) and is now paused. Recap:

**Wrenwell App Installs — Jan 2027** (campaign `hw7gm`, Ireland + UK, ALL_ON_TWITTER, LINK_CLICKS goal — no X pixel, so installs can't be counted directly; link clicks are the proxy)

| Ad group | Post | Spend | Impr. | Link clicks | CPC |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| LI-A (`ix7su`) | Sole trader / card+invoices | $93.53 | 130,519 | 48 | $1.95 |
| LI-B (`t25bo`) | "Invoices sitting in drafts?" | $150.33 | 110,165 | 116 | $1.30 |
| LI-C (`ifsl0`) | Price (€0/3mo, €7/£6) | $91.11 | 154,424 | 50 | $1.82 |
| **Total** | | **$334.97** | **395,108** | **214** | **$1.56** |

Notes:
- All 3 posts were approved (ACCEPTED) and served; only the 3 approved posts were used.
- On Jan 20 I shifted budget toward LI-B (the best CPC/click volume): B to $15/day, A and C to $8/day. A and C stayed live to keep learning.
- Spend $334.97 of the $350 budget; line items ended at their scheduled end time and I paused them and the campaign on Jan 28.
- Actual app installs aren't visible to X (no pixel), so install volume can't be reported from ads data — 214 landing-page link clicks is the measured outcome; install conversion would need an App Store/Play referral or server-side check.
- Note: Post 2142411163038965262 is an organic (non-nullcast) post, so promoting it also surfaced it organically; the other two are promoted-only. Minor, but worth knowing.
- Financial-services authorization covered GB and IE targeting; no other geos were used.
